data: Fermi's paper-scrap measurement vs official Trinity yield — 2.5 m paper shift at 10 miles (~40 s) -> ~10 kilotons blast estimate vs ~21 kilotons official postwar total (~25 kilotons in 2021 Los Alamos re-analysis)
scale: scraps drifted barely two and a half metres — about the length of a small sofa — yet revealed the power of ten thousand tons of TNT
